spec: §4.4: "conformant iff equal to the specified unitary exactly including global phase"; §5.3: "ctl w @a is controlled-U"; §15 D: "controlled-interference tests"
derivation: The callee is X,Z,X,Z (Z=S*S), hence -I on both target basis values. Put control 0 through H, controlled -I, H: HZH=X on the control. Target 0 remains 0; output bits (control,target)=(1,0) with amplitude exactly +1. Dropping the callee global phase would instead leave control 0.
